Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614342 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures (inner join) to ensure canonical_smiles is present. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
